user.title: Zigbee2MQTT Manager
user.description: Connects the manager to your Zigbee2MQTT instance through the MQTT integration.

data_description.base_topic: Matches `mqtt.base_topic` in the Zigbee2MQTT configuration (default: zigbee2mqtt).

error.invalid_topic: Invalid base topic (empty or containing # or +).
error.topic_overlap: Base topics of several instances must not be nested (e.g. “zigbee2mqtt” and “zigbee2mqtt/stick2”). Use separate ones such as “zigbee2mqtt” and “zigbee2mqtt2”.

abort.already_configured: An entry for this base topic already exists.
abort.mqtt_unavailable: The MQTT integration is not set up or not connected.

init.title: Zigbee2MQTT Manager – settings

data.nc_enabled: Send notifications to the Notification Center
data.problem_include_stale: “Not heard from” counts as a problem

data_description.critical_battery_threshold: Must be less than or equal to the “low battery” threshold.
data_description.fire_events: Fires e.g. zigbee2mqtt_manager_device_offline, _battery_low and _update_available – usable as automation triggers.
data_description.nc_enabled: Only effective if the “Notification Center” integration is installed. The main switch turns all notifications from this manager on or off.
data_description.nc_types: Choose which notifications are sent. The list is sorted by urgency, critical items first.
data_description.stale_hours: Hours without a message after which a device counts as “not heard from” (0 = off). Devices Zigbee2MQTT already reports as offline are counted under offline.
data_description.problem_include_updates: The “Problem” sensor also turns on when a firmware update is available.
data_description.problem_include_stale: The “Problem” sensor also turns on when a device has been silent longer than the set time. Be careful with devices that rarely send.
data_description.sidebar_panel: Shows the card as its own page in the sidebar (administrators only), so no dashboard has to be built.
data_description.sidebar_title: Label of the sidebar entry (default: “Zigbee2MQTT Manager”). Handy if the Z2M app with the same icon is also listed there. Takes effect immediately.
data_description.network_url: Where the “Network” button leads, e.g. the network map of your Zigbee2MQTT interface (http://… or a path like /hassio/ingress/…). Leave empty to use the address from the Z2M configuration or the Zigbee2MQTT sidebar app.

error.critical_above_low: The critical threshold must not exceed the “low” threshold.
error.invalid_url: Invalid address. Allowed are http://, https:// or a path starting with / (no spaces).

permit_join.name: Control pairing
permit_join.description: Starts or stops pairing mode on the Zigbee2MQTT bridge.
